tenderSchedule.title: Providing pump operators & chemist/ supervisor for Anjanapura Jackwell cum Pumphouse, WTPs (2-units / 3.63 & 3.80 MLD) & clear water pumphouse under Bulk water supply M & R works to Shikaripura town on outsourcing basis for 12 months under DC works of TMC Shikaripura town
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Urban Water Supply and Drainage Board

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions as per bid document
Amount put to bid is excluding GST
Rates should be quoated in Rs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have supplied Manpower/pump operator/Semi skilled labours of total 13 Nos. to Govt / Semi Govt / ULB through outsource for a minimum period of 12 months in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26

Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime successful bidder for at least one similar nature of work(As specified in the above parameter column of Clause B) to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work i.e. Rs.15.60 Lakhs
Bidder in his name should have in last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 31.19 Lakhs.
